title: Landlord checklist HTML view (mission item 3) copy has no text assertion
evidence:
server/src/content/tenant_vetting_checklist_view.gleam:103
      "Ask for references from the current and previous landlord, and an employer — or a client, accountant, or business contact if the applicant is self-employed. Then actually contact them.",
server/test/content/content_test.gleam:907
      tenant_vetting_checklist_view.render(
server/test/content/content_test.gleam:977
        "<meta content=\"" <> card_url <> "\" property=\"og:image\">",
server/test/content/content_test.gleam:1599
    html |> string.contains("posthog.init(") |> should.be_true
detail: Mission item 3 changed this line; every other W1a checklist surface (invite, auto-reply, prep-block) got a substring assertion, but this view's render tests assert only og:image / posthog — coherence drift passes CI.
recommended_fix: In a tenant_vetting_checklist_view render test add `html |> string.contains("or from a client, accountant, or business contact if the applicant is self-employed") |> should.be_true` to pin the W1a doctrine.

title: PDF template copy changes verified only by smoke/file-exists, not by text
evidence:
server/priv/templates/audit_report.typ:1044
  #text(font: "Geist", weight: 500, size: 10pt, fill: slate)[Employer / business reference]
server/priv/templates/audit_report.typ:1072
#field-line("Employer / business reference", provided(app.documents.employer_ref))
server/priv/templates/tenant-vetting-checklist.typ:74
  "Ask for references from the current and previous landlord, and an employer — or a client, accountant, or business contact if the applicant is self-employed. Then actually contact them.",
server/test/ai/audit_report_test.gleam:219
      bit_array.byte_size(pdf_bytes) |> should.not_equal(0)
server/test/ai/audit_report_test.gleam:220
      bit_array.slice(pdf_bytes, 0, 5) |> should.equal(Ok(<<"%PDF-":utf8>>))
server/test/content/content_test.gleam:848
  simplifile.read_bits("priv/static/templates/tenant-vetting-checklist.pdf")
detail: Both .typ label changes render to PDF; tests assert only non-empty bytes or that the PDF file exists, so a reverted or drifted label ships undetected.
recommended_fix: Assert the .typ source substring directly in a unit test (read the priv template file), or extract rendered PDF text via typst, to pin the label end-to-end.

title: upload_required_message copy change unasserted (keys tested, messages not)
evidence:
server/src/application/application_handler.gleam:964
      "Upload an employer / business reference confirming your work."
server/src/application/application_handler.gleam:969
      "Upload an employer / business reference for "
server/test/application/application_handler_test.gleam:783
  |> list.any(fn(e) { e.0 == "employer_ref_primary" })
server/test/application/application_handler_test.gleam:866
  |> list.any(fn(e) { e.0 == "employer_ref_coapplicant_0" })
detail: validate_files_presence tests assert only the error field key (e.0), never the message text (e.1), so the new employer/business wording in upload-required errors isn't pinned.
recommended_fix: Extend one validate_files_presence test to assert the full #(key, message) tuple, e.g. #("employer_ref_primary", "Upload an employer / business reference confirming your work.").

title: Employer count-cap rejection message unasserted (over-cap test never rejects)
evidence:
server/src/application/document_upload.gleam:105
const max_employer_ref: Int = 4
server/src/application/document_upload.gleam:167
          "One employer / business reference per adult \u{2014} that\u{2019}s four at most.",
server/test/application/document_upload_test.gleam (employer_ref_over_cap_is_rejected_test)
    file("employer_ref_primary", "a.pdf"),
    file("employer_ref_coapplicant_0", "b.pdf"),
    file("employer_ref_coapplicant_1", "c.pdf"),
    file("employer_ref_coapplicant_2", "d.pdf"),
    ...
    document_upload.ReadyToUpload(ready) ->
      ready |> list_length_should_equal(4)
detail: The over-cap test submits exactly max_employer_ref (4) and asserts ReadyToUpload, so the cap-rejection branch and its new message never execute under test; only duplicate keys could exceed the cap.
recommended_fix: Add a test submitting five files all on employer_ref_primary (count 5 > cap 4) to hit PrecheckRejected and assert the new message verbatim.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (none in scope); P1 100% (the one logic change, evidence_humanize.display_label_for_key, is fully covered). Overall text-assertion coverage ≈55%: landlord checklist HTML, both PDF templates, the count-cap and upload-required messages lack assertions.
recommended_fix: Pin the landlord checklist HTML view (completes the W1a doctrine); optionally assert the count-cap and upload-required messages. Raises overall copy-assertion coverage above 80%.
